capabilities: Import Wikidata properties for the active file from its entity id
Add a wikidata entity id property to a note
Import new Wikidata entities as notes
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull structured data from Wikidata into note properties.
summary: Wikidata importer that fills a note's properties from a Wikidata entity and can create new notes from Wikidata entries.
